time.desc: The company appoints a new independent auditor and submits a compliance plan to the exchange to avoid the risk of delisting due to delays in submitting annual reports.
The exchange approved the extension of the company's listing period to a specified date and required the submission of overdue financial reports.

The company's special committee announced its final investigation results, confirming that no fraud or misconduct by management was found and that corporate governance deficiencies did not constitute a major weakness.
After the results of the investigation by Company A's special committee were announced, the company's stock price soared by about 29% that day, closing at about 42 yuan.

The board of directors of Company A adopts the recommendation of the special committee, appoints a new chief accounting officer and approves the transition arrangements for the chief financial officer.
The exchange formally approved the company's application to delay the submission of financial reports and allowed it to maintain listing and trading status before the specified date.
After Company A was approved by the exchange for an extension, the stock price of Region F surged by about 11.7% in night trading, with a cumulative increase of nearly 80% in the past month.
After Company A was approved by the exchange for an extension, one investment bank maintained a sell rating and another bank maintained a hold rating.
Company A announced that it received a letter from the exchange and was allowed to extend the period to meet the listing requirements to a specified date, temporarily avoiding the risk of delisting.
Analysts raised their target prices significantly after the company submitted extension filing documents
Company A files a Form C document indicating that its shares will continue to trade on the exchange under the supervision of a new external auditor
An analyst firm raised its price target to 60 Currency A after Company A filed for an extension.
The company was officially removed from the major market index because its market capitalization fell below the inclusion criteria
After the news that Company A was removed from the major market index was announced, the stock price fell by approximately 8% that day.

Company A's special committee recommended the replacement of its chief financial officer during its investigation, and the company stated that the current chief financial officer will remain in office until a replacement is found.
The company's decision to be removed from the main market index officially takes effect and the constituent stocks are replaced
A well-known short-selling institution announced its dissolution, and its founder said that the phased tasks have been completed
The company confirmed that it will submit a delayed annual report for the fiscal year before the cutoff, directly mitigating the risk of forced delisting.
The company's CEO gave out high forward revenue forecasts for the first time and also lowered the current year's revenue guidance.

The CEO of Company A predicted for the first time that revenue in fiscal year 2026 will reach 40 billion currency A, and at the same time lowered the revenue forecast for fiscal year 2025 to 23.5 billion to 25 billion currency A
After Company A updated its listing plan, its stock price soared by about 12% in early trading.

The company submitted overdue annual reports and quarterly reports to the regulatory agency and successfully avoided delisting. The exchange confirmed that the company again complied with the listing application requirements.
After Company A submitted its overdue annual and quarterly reports before the cutoff, its stock price soared more than 24% in after-hours trading.

The company submitted a supplementary financial report and disclosed that revenue doubled but gross profit margin dropped significantly, confirming that there is no need to restate and completing the compliance case.

Company A's supplementary financial report disclosed that the net profit of the last fiscal year increased by approximately 80% year-on-year, and the revenue increased by approximately 110%, but the gross profit margin fell from 18% to approximately 13.8%.
The company appoints new independent directors and promotes general counsel to strengthen corporate governance structure
The company released quarterly unaudited financial results, with gross profit margins falling sharply and net profits falling significantly.
The company disclosed that there were major deficiencies in the internal control over financial reporting and failed to operate effectively, and it has initiated corrective measures.

The company’s co-founder and CEO was arrested and faces multiple federal criminal charges for allegedly illegally smuggling high-end chips to certain countries through a network of affiliated companies.
Company board member resigns as director, company appoints acting chief compliance officer
The company's independent directors launched an independent investigation to verify employees' suspected smuggling of chips to specific countries.
The company announced the appointment of a chief compliance officer and separated the compliance function from financial responsibilities. The brokerage lowered the company's rating and target price.

The company's board of directors announced the appointment of specific personnel to lead the internal investigation, hire independent consultants and coordinate with the audit agency to report the results.
